statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, the following holds. Call a finite sequence (g_0,...,g_k) of byte strings a valid mutation sequence of length k from startGene to endGene if: g_0 = startGene and g_k = endGene; for every i with 0 <= i < k, g_i and g_{i+1} both have length 8 and there is exactly one index p with 0 <= p < 8 such that g_i[p] != g_{i+1}[p] (all other positions are equal); and for every i with 1 <= i <= k, there exists j with 0 <= j < len(bank) such that bank[j] equals g_i byte for byte. Then if some valid mutation sequence of length k with k >= 0 exists, r is the least such k; otherwise r = -1.
preconditions: len(startGene) = 8, len(endGene) = 8, len(bank) <= 10, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(bank), len(bank[i]) = 8. Every byte of startGene, endGene, and every bank[i] is one of 65 ('A'), 67 ('C'), 71 ('G'), 84 ('T').

statement: The function returns a result r (it does not fail, panic, overflow, or access out of bounds) for every input satisfying the preconditions.
preconditions: len(startGene) = 8, len(endGene) = 8, len(bank) <= 10, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(bank), len(bank[i]) = 8. Every byte of startGene, endGene, and every bank[i] is one of 65 ('A'), 67 ('C'), 71 ('G'), 84 ('T').

statement: Whenever the function returns r, either r = -1, or 0 <= r <= len(bank).
preconditions: len(startGene) = 8, len(endGene) = 8, len(bank) <= 10, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(bank), len(bank[i]) = 8. Every byte of startGene, endGene, and every bank[i] is one of 65 ('A'), 67 ('C'), 71 ('G'), 84 ('T').

statement: Whenever the function returns r, r = 0 if and only if startGene = endGene (same bytes at all 8 positions).
preconditions: len(startGene) = 8, len(endGene) = 8, len(bank) <= 10, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(bank), len(bank[i]) = 8. Every byte of startGene, endGene, and every bank[i] is one of 65 ('A'), 67 ('C'), 71 ('G'), 84 ('T').

statement: Whenever the function returns r, if r > 0 then endGene is present in bank: there exists j with 0 <= j < len(bank) such that bank[j] equals endGene byte for byte.
preconditions: len(startGene) = 8, len(endGene) = 8, len(bank) <= 10, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(bank), len(bank[i]) = 8. Every byte of startGene, endGene, and every bank[i] is one of 65 ('A'), 67 ('C'), 71 ('G'), 84 ('T').

statement: Whenever the function returns r, if endGene is not present in bank (there is no j with 0 <= j < len(bank) and bank[j] = endGene byte for byte), then r = 0 when startGene = endGene, and r = -1 when startGene != endGene.
preconditions: len(startGene) = 8, len(endGene) = 8, len(bank) <= 10, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(bank), len(bank[i]) = 8. Every byte of startGene, endGene, and every bank[i] is one of 65 ('A'), 67 ('C'), 71 ('G'), 84 ('T').

statement: Whenever the function returns r, r = 1 if and only if startGene and endGene differ in exactly one position p with 0 <= p < 8 (all other positions are equal), and endGene is present in bank.
preconditions: len(startGene) = 8, len(endGene) = 8, len(bank) <= 10, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(bank), len(bank[i]) = 8. Every byte of startGene, endGene, and every bank[i] is one of 65 ('A'), 67 ('C'), 71 ('G'), 84 ('T').

statement: Whenever the function returns r, if r > 0 then there exists an index j with 0 <= j < len(bank) such that startGene and bank[j] differ in exactly one of the 8 positions, and there exists a valid mutation sequence of length r - 1 from bank[j] to endGene using bank, meaning a sequence (h_0,...,h_{r-1}) with h_0 = bank[j], h_{r-1} = endGene, every consecutive pair differs in exactly one of the 8 positions, and every h_i with 1 <= i <= r - 1 is present in bank.
preconditions: len(startGene) = 8, len(endGene) = 8, len(bank) <= 10, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(bank), len(bank[i]) = 8. Every byte of startGene, endGene, and every bank[i] is one of 65 ('A'), 67 ('C'), 71 ('G'), 84 ('T').

statement: Whenever the function returns r with r >= 0, there exists a valid mutation sequence (g_0,...,g_r) of length r from startGene to endGene using bank such that g_0,g_1,...,g_r are pairwise distinct byte strings.
preconditions: len(startGene) = 8, len(endGene) = 8, len(bank) <= 10, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(bank), len(bank[i]) = 8. Every byte of startGene, endGene, and every bank[i] is one of 65 ('A'), 67 ('C'), 71 ('G'), 84 ('T').

statement: Whenever the function returns r for (startGene,endGene,bank), the function returns r for (startGene,endGene,bank2) as well.
preconditions: len(startGene) = 8, len(endGene) = 8, len(bank) <= 10, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(bank), len(bank[i]) = 8. Every byte of startGene, endGene, and every bank[i] is one of 65 ('A'), 67 ('C'), 71 ('G'), 84 ('T'). Let bank2 be any slice of Vec<U8> satisfying the same length, alphabet, and at-most-10 preconditions, and such that for every 8-byte gene string g over {A,C,G,T}, g is present in bank exactly when g is present in bank2.

statement: Whenever the function returns r for (startGene,endGene,bank), if startGene is present in bank, then for the bank2 obtained from bank by deleting every entry equal to startGene byte for byte, the function returns r for (startGene,endGene,bank2).
preconditions: len(startGene) = 8, len(endGene) = 8, len(bank) <= 10, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(bank), len(bank[i]) = 8. Every byte of startGene, endGene, and every bank[i] is one of 65 ('A'), 67 ('C'), 71 ('G'), 84 ('T').

statement: Whenever the function returns r1 for (startGene,endGene,bank1) and r2 for (startGene,endGene,bank2), either r1 = -1, or (r2 >= 0 and r2 <= r1).
preconditions: len(startGene) = 8, len(endGene) = 8, and every byte of startGene and endGene is one of 65 ('A'), 67 ('C'), 71 ('G'), 84 ('T'). Let bank1 and bank2 be slices of Vec<U8> both satisfying len <= 10, every entry has length 8 and uses only A,C,G,T, and suppose every gene string present in bank1 is also present in bank2.

statement: Whenever the function returns r, if startGene != endGene and there is no index j with 0 <= j < len(bank) such that startGene and bank[j] differ in exactly one of the 8 positions, then r = -1.
preconditions: len(startGene) = 8, len(endGene) = 8, len(bank) <= 10, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(bank), len(bank[i]) = 8. Every byte of startGene, endGene, and every bank[i] is one of 65 ('A'), 67 ('C'), 71 ('G'), 84 ('T').

statement: Whenever the function returns r with r > 0, bank contains at least r pairwise distinct byte strings: there exist indices j_1,...,j_r with 0 <= j_m < len(bank) such that bank[j_1],...,bank[j_r] are pairwise unequal as byte sequences.
preconditions: len(startGene) = 8, len(endGene) = 8, len(bank) <= 10, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(bank), len(bank[i]) = 8. Every byte of startGene, endGene, and every bank[i] is one of 65 ('A'), 67 ('C'), 71 ('G'), 84 ('T').
